description: Get the largest keys from key analytics snapshots, ranked by measured memory usage. Coverage note: snapshots track the biggest collections by element count, so a memory-heavy key with few elements may not be tracked. Companion to get_hot_keys, which ranks by access frequency. Use to find memory hogs, bloated hashes/sets, or candidates for TTL/eviction. Requires BetterDB Pro (keyAnalytics).
name: get_largest_keys
